episodes.title: Introduction to Rhetoric and Composition
episodes.description: Emily Zarka provides an introduction into the study of Rhetoric and Composition.

episodes.title: How to Grow as a Writer
episodes.description: Explore literacies and the factors that shape how people read, understand, and create writing.

episodes.title: Purpose: What's Writing For, Anyway?
episodes.description: Writing is a useful tool, but it has to be adjusted to fit the purpose a piece has.

episodes.title: The Writing Process
episodes.description: Use invention, planning, drafting, revision, and editing to make writing more effective and manageable.

episodes.title: Writing in Action: A Writer's Journal
episodes.description: Emily Zarka discusses different ways to create a writer's journal and why these are particularly useful.

episodes.title: The Writing Process: Invention and Planning
episodes.description: Break writing into manageable tasks through invention and planning.

episodes.title: The Writing Process: Drafting
episodes.description: Emily Zarka dives into the process of drafting and how it can help us create our best writing!

episodes.title: The Writing Process: Revision
episodes.description: Explore revision as an alternative to the pursuit of a perfect first attempt.

episodes.title: The Writing Process: Editing
episodes.description: Use editing to identify choices that might interfere with the impact of a text.

episodes.title: How to Write a Cover Letter or Personal Statement
episodes.description: Develop cover letters and personal statements that persuasively present your experience and goals.

episodes.title: Get to Know Your Audience
episodes.description: In this episode we discuss audience and how we can adjust our writing purposefully to achieve our goals and connect with our readers!

episodes.title: Writing for Non-Human Audiences
episodes.description: Emily Zarka discusses non-human audiences and how communicating with them can bring our writing to our intended human audience.

episodes.title: Invention & Planning Techniques
episodes.description: Explore techniques for generating ideas and planning when inspiration is hard to find.

episodes.title: How to write a Resume
episodes.description: Use résumé guidelines to present relevant information clearly to hiring managers.

episodes.title: Introducing Context: Place and Space
episodes.description: Emily Zarka discusses context as it relates to space and place and the complex role it plays in our writing!

episodes.title: Context: Media
episodes.description: Emily Zarka discusses the kinds of context created by the media we use.

episodes.title: Context in Time
episodes.description: Emily Zarka discusses how and why time is an important element to account for in our writing.

episodes.title: Drafting Techniques
episodes.description: Explore drafting techniques that sustain momentum and provide direction for a writing project.

episodes.title: A Remediation Analysis
episodes.description: Analyze how effectively a project uses its medium and consider how it could work in a different form.

episodes.title: Introducing Purpose and Strategies
episodes.description: By evaluating the purpose and strategies used in other people's writing we can improve our own!

episodes.title: The Elements of Rhetorical Analysis
episodes.description: Use rhetorical analysis to investigate a text’s meaning, purpose, and effectiveness.

episodes.title: Citation, Quotation, and Paraphrase
episodes.description: Joining a conversation rather than writing alone is a big part of why we have to cite, quote, and paraphrase.

episodes.title: Revision Techniques
episodes.description: In this episode, we discuss different revision techniques that can help us take our writing in different directions we may not have thought of before.

episodes.title: Writing in Action: Creating a Rhetorical Analysis
episodes.description: Apply rhetorical analysis to formal writing projects and everyday reflection.

episodes.title: Writing Skills are Life Skills
episodes.description: Explore how awareness of thinking and learning helps writing skills transfer across situations.

episodes.title: Rhetorical Analysis and Transfer
episodes.description: Rhetorical analysis can seem like a big undertaking but it mostly comes down to using fact-finding skills and asking questions.

episodes.title: The Writing Process and Transfer
episodes.description: Adapt the stages of the writing process to other personal and professional projects.

episodes.title: Editing Techniques
episodes.description: Explore editing tools for style, grammar, and formatting that help convey meaning clearly.

episodes.title: Writing Practice: The Reflective Essay
episodes.description: Writing a reflective essay is one way to take serious time to think about an important moment or experience.
